generator.tabs.label: Sections
generator.title: Password generator
generator.mode.label: What to make
generator.copied: Copied. Ferret clears the clipboard after 30 seconds, even if you copy something else in between.
generator.filled: Filled in the new password fields of the page.
generator.filled_short: Filled in the new password fields of the page. The field takes at most {length} characters, so the password was made {length} characters long.
generator.no_page: Open Ferret on the page with the sign-up or change-password form to fill it in. Here you can still make and copy a password.
generator.keep: Ferret keeps this value in memory only, until the vault locks or 15 minutes have passed. It is not saved anywhere until you save it.
generator.options.avoid_ambiguous: Leave out look-alike characters (such as O and 0)
generator.error.not_offered: Ferret no longer keeps this value. Make a new one.
generator.error.nothing_kept: Ferret keeps no value now. Make a new one.
generator.error.invalid_input: These options cannot be used together. Change them.
generator.error.origin_changed: The page changed while Ferret worked, so nothing was filled. Try again.
generator.error.busy: Ferret is already filling something. Try again in a moment.
generator.error.frame_gone: The form is gone from the page.
generator.error.no_report: The page did not answer. Try again.
generator.error.no_fields: Ferret found no form on this page that sets a new password.
generator.error.no_answer: The page did not take the value. Try again.
generator.error.value_too_long: The value is too long for the field.
generator.error.wrong_kind: The page changed while Ferret worked, so nothing was filled.
generator.error.covered: Something covers the password field, so Ferret did not fill it.
generator.error.frame_hidden: The form is hidden or covered on the page, so Ferret did not fill it.
generator.error.frame_unchecked: The form is in a frame inside another frame that Ferret has no access to, so Ferret could not check that the form is shown and did not fill it.
generator.error.field_too_short: Ferret fills in a generated password only when it has at least 8 characters and fits the field, and a passphrase only when it fits whole. This one does not, so nothing was filled. Make another one, or copy this one and fill it in yourself.
generator.error.insecure_page: This page is not encrypted, so Ferret does not fill a new password into it.
generator.error.clipboard: Ferret could not write to the clipboard.
generator.error.not_cleared: Copied, but Ferret could not set the timer that clears the clipboard. Clear it yourself when you have pasted.
